newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia Airlines plane overshoots runway.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia Airlines plane overshoots runway.

text.p: A Malaysia Airlines jetliner landing in a heavy thunderstorm at the Buenos Aires international airport on Wednesday overshot the runway but steered to a safe landing, the airline said.
In a statement issued on Thursday, the airline said none of the 268 passengers and 17 crew on board flight MH 201 from Johannesburg to the Argentine capital were injured.
The MD-11 aircraft, which had been wet leased by Malaysia's national carrier from World Airways, "suffered no serious damage" in the incident, the statement said.
Under the arrangement, Malaysia Airlines leased the aircraft and crew including the pilot from World Airways, but supplied its own cabin crew.
Malaysia Airlines said it would resume operations to Johannesburg, Cape Town and Buenos Aires with "minor retimings" using replacement aircraft.
